risk_note: Admin console users page (apps/admin; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2, so the Codex review ran on the money track). List (user.list, risk-state filter with the board labels, paging), lookup (user.lookup, exactly one of uid / full phone, the three 20001 cases shown by the box), lookup-only accounts see only the lookup box; detail with basic fields, inviter link and read-only union bindings; full phone reveal with a reason (1..200) and totp step-up, kept only in memory. Only contract fields; tabs, invitees, level / parent changes, balance, ban / freeze, export wait for CT-24 / F1-07g. The conflict with frozen AC-F1-06i-LIST#3 was resolved by test-change F1-06zh (#785). Rule tests by Codex in two calls, Claude spec-test review 2 rounds pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (the first run was cut off by a session restart without output, not counted; the resumed run finished); test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/2 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, one S2 (a late lookup response can replace a detail opened meanwhile) tracked in followups
